name: Borderlands 4: Bounty Pack 3 - A Zane to Kill For
storyline:
Zane Flynt is dead.

Wait, scratch that: it's his Digi-Clone that's been murdered, sent to that big trash folder in the sky. Now the actual Zane wants you to nab the scumbag who deleted his Digistructed twin. You'll need to do some detective work in the virtual realm, warping into a pair of classic arcade machines to hunt down the culprit.
summary: Investigate the murder of Zane Flynt's Digi-Clone in this neon-noir mystery that pulls you into the digital realm of classic arcade machines. Hunt down the culprit responsible for deleting Zane's virtual twin by chasing leads and battling new Glitched enemies that shift positions mid-combat. Unravel the case in this repeatable mission centered on the infamous hitman-turned-Vault Hunter as you face off against a new boss and mini-bosses to claim powerful loot and exclusive rewards.
